QUOTE: The library creates no threads. `pthread_create` appears only in `programs/ssl/ssl_pthread_server.c`, which is an example.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer states the library creates no threads, but it frames the mutex layer as compiled out by default. It never says that library/ supplies the mutex abstraction for threaded callers. It only lists the mutexes as used when THREADING_C is on, which doesn't state the contrast.
